name: Beatrice
source:
Liam's childhood friend, she lives in the same street and has been in the same class with him since both were in kindergarten. Even thought she spends a lot of time together with him, he fails to notice that she has developed feelings that go way beyond friendship. In her first school year, she opted in for the cooking club.

[From [url=https://twitter.com/innocenceversus/status/1013875989649256448] Twitter[/url]]
